items.description: Map repository modules and execution flow for gravity-sim research tooling
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/repo_analysis/module_map.md` that lists every non-generated module (`.archivara/*.py`, `.opencode/tools/*.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, and root docs), each module's purpose, and at least one upstream/downstream dependency per module.

items.description: Formulate the core gravity-simulation research question, hypotheses, and success metrics
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/problem_definition.md` with one primary research question, at least 3 testable hypotheses, and quantitative targets for energy drift, angular-momentum drift, trajectory error, and runtime.

items.description: Run web-based literature and repository scan for state-of-the-art gravity simulation
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute web searches covering papers and code repositories, then log at least 30 candidate sources in `results/literature/raw_search_log.json` with query, URL, source type, and relevance score.

items.description: Create and maintain canonical bibliography in sources.bib
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `sources.bib` at repo root with BibTeX entries for all consulted sources, including at least 10 relevant papers and at least 3 public code repositories used for method comparison.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis subagents to derive literature gaps and seed the concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one exploration subagent and one synthesis subagent, store outputs under `results/literature/subagents/`, and create `results/concept_evolve/tree/gap_to_concept_map.json` with at least 8 concept nodes linked to explicit citations in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Specify baseline simulator architecture and module interfaces
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/baseline/architecture_spec.md` defining module boundaries (state model, force model, integrator, timestep control, visualization/CLI, metrics) and explicit interface contracts between them.

items.description: Implement a deterministic minimal baseline gravity simulator
items.acceptance_criteria: Deliver a runnable baseline supporting at least 2-body and 3-body scenarios with fixed seed control and command-line parameters, and document exact run commands in `results/baseline/runbook.md`.

items.description: Instrument baseline metrics for physical fidelity and performance
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/baseline/metrics_schema.json` and `results/baseline/baseline_metrics.json` containing energy drift, angular-momentum drift, position RMSE vs analytic 2-body orbit, runtime (ms/step), and memory usage.

items.description: Benchmark baseline and align outcomes with prior work
items.acceptance_criteria: Evaluate baseline on predefined scenarios and write `results/baseline/literature_comparison.md` comparing results against at least 3 methods or repositories cited in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis subagents for baseline failure analysis
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one exploration subagent to inspect baseline failure modes and one synthesis subagent to prioritize fixes; save outputs in `results/baseline/subagents/` and update `results/concept_evolve/tree/baseline_failure_paths.json` with at least 3 actionable concept branches.

items.description: Traverse concept tree and select highest-value novel research branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Perform structured traversal of `results/concept_evolve/tree/` and create `results/research/selected_branches.json` selecting 3 branches with dependency chains, expected gains, and cited prior-work anchors.

items.description: Prototype Novel Approach A centered on improved integration accuracy
items.acceptance_criteria: Implement and document Approach A (e.g., higher-order or symplectic variant) with reproducible configuration, conservation checks, and outputs matching the Phase 2 metric schema.

items.description: Prototype Novel Approach B centered on computational scalability
items.acceptance_criteria: Implement and document Approach B (e.g., Barnes-Hut or near-far force split) including complexity characterization and outputs matching the Phase 2 metric schema.

items.description: Design ablation matrix across baseline and novel components
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/research/ablation_plan.md` covering baseline, Approach A only, Approach B only, and hybrid variants with fixed datasets, seeds, and pass/fail criteria tied to Phase 1 targets.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis subagents to prune and merge novel directions
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration subagent for edge-case discovery and one synthesis subagent for final direction selection; produce `results/research/approach_selection.md` citing at least 5 relevant entries from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Define experiment matrix and reproducibility protocol
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/experiments/experiment_matrix.json` specifying scenarios, parameter sweeps, random seeds, hardware metadata, and at least 3 repeated runs per condition.

items.description: Execute controlled experiments for baseline and selected novel methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/experiments/main_results.csv` and `results/experiments/statistics.json` with mean, standard deviation, and 95% confidence intervals for all tracked metrics.

items.description: Run stress, stability, and scaling evaluations
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate `results/experiments/scaling_report.md` with body-count scaling curves, timestep sensitivity boundaries, and identified failure thresholds.

items.description: Compare final method against prior work from literature review
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/experiments/prior_work_comparison.md` containing at least 5 side-by-side comparisons to papers or repositories in `sources.bib`, with explicit win/tie/loss annotations per metric.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis subagents for anomaly triage and concept-tree feedback
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one exploration subagent to analyze the top 3 anomalous runs and one synthesis subagent to propose follow-up experiments; save outputs under `results/experiments/subagents/` and update `results/concept_evolve/tree/anomaly_feedback.json`.

items.description: Synthesize evidence to answer the core research question
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/analysis/final_findings.md` that evaluates every Phase 1 hypothesis as supported/unsupported, with direct metric evidence and uncertainty notes.

items.description: Prepare publication-grade figures and result tables
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce at least 6 figures in `figures/` (trajectory, conservation, and scaling visuals) and a `results/analysis/figure_index.md` that maps each figure to the claim it supports.

items.description: Assemble reproducibility and project handoff documentation
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `README.md` and add `results/analysis/reproducibility_checklist.md` with setup steps, exact commands, expected outputs, and known limitations.

items.description: Audit bibliography quality and citation coverage
items.acceptance_criteria: Verify all major analysis claims cite entries in `sources.bib`; ensure the bibliography keeps at least 10 papers and 3 code repositories with unique BibTeX keys and no unresolved placeholders.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis subagents for mock peer review and revision planning
items.acceptance_criteria: Run a reviewer-style exploration subagent and a writer-style synthesis subagent; store outputs in `results/analysis/subagents/` and produce `results/analysis/revision_plan.md` that addresses at least 10 actionable review comments.
